doc.title: Yusef Lateef — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Interruption over whether he is crying
summary: A crew member asks if Lateef needs a minute; he explains he has a cataract.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Tape changes, reel headers and session breaks

blocks.x: I see. Now, uh, again–I have an uncle was a preacher who would always say, “Well, we’re just going to go back to the theme hear”–but, again, looking metaphorically at, at uh, at, at your career and this, this notion of–[speaking to someone off to the side] yes?
I’m sorry. Do you need a minute?
Do you need a, you’re, are you crying?
Oh okay. I thought you might–
Yeah. It was moving. I thought maybe you needed a minute.
No, that’s quite, that’s quite alright. That’s quite alright.
And, while we’re stopped, [to Yusef] are you comfortable?
